Acts as an interactive coach using the C139 deal-winning probability model (1W + 3F + 9C) to guide students through real project reviews. Triggers when: user mentions a real project they want coaching on, asks for C139 assessment, says they need help evaluating a deal, mentions keywords like "项目攻关" "赢单概率" "C139" "教练" "项目指导" "关键人突破" "竞争应对", or explicitly invokes this skill. The coach uses evidence-based questioning to challenge assumptions, verify judgments, and guide students to their own conclusions and action plans.
